title: Seoul · Gangwon Mountain Run
slogan: A long mountain-and-coast day for early starts.
story: A long mountain-and-coast day for early starts. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 156 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Daegwallyeong high road, Gangneung coast, Odaesan return roads, while Hongcheon fuel and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Daegwallyeong high road → Gangneung coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 29 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

title: Seoul · Bukhan River and Gapyeong Roads
